scan_findings.detail: Escaped '<' to \u003c before injecting JSON.stringify(jobPostingSchema) into a JSON-LD <script> tag to prevent breakout via job title/description containing </script>.
Test fixtures, placeholder/template values (CHANGEME base64), or env-var references. No literal production secret values present.

All pass through sanitizeHtml/sanitizeEmailHtml/sanitizeAnnouncementHtml (DOMPurify, allowlisted tags/attrs, FORBID_TAGS script/iframe/object/embed/form/input) or render static/non-user content (theme-script.ts FOUC script, Mantine internal style injection).
Unused design-mockup reference directories, not part of frontend/ build, not deployed. Left untouched per explicit instruction not to delete solely to satisfy the scanner.
Playwright page.$eval/$$eval API, not the eval() global.
Security regression tests asserting SQL-injection payloads do NOT succeed (expect(has500).toBe(false), etc.).
execFile/execFileSync called with argument arrays, no shell:true, not shell-interpolated. Not injectable.

Localhost-only developer tooling (agent orchestration visualizer), not part of the shipped frontend/backend. Dynamic values pass through a local esc() helper (unit-tested in orchestrator-client-core.test.js).
